name: Sync.ME
notes: One request per saved phone number, each with its own reply address. The form asks for an email and the phone number, then a reCAPTCHA (solved by a CAPTCHA helper, or it waits on the CAPTCHAs page). Sync.ME says removal is done within 24 hours.
source: Form fields and timing per CrabClear's Sync.ME opt-out guide (checked 2026-07-27).
